title: TC-FedIDS: Trajectory-Aware Federated Intrusion Detection with Environment-Invariant Aggregation and Empirical Byzantine Robustness under Differential Privacy
description:
This repository contains the source code, experimental results (tables and figures), and draft manuscript for TC-FedIDS, a trajectory-aware federated intrusion-detection framework.

TC-FedIDS combines (1) multi-round client-update trajectory descriptors (direction persistence, spectral entropy, second-order acceleration, norm variance) fused into an exponential-moving-average trust weight, (2) environment-invariant GroupDRO-style aggregation with a Huber regulariser centred at the coordinate-wise median and solved by FISTA, and (3) an empirical Byzantine robustness evaluation under Rényi differential privacy.

Experiments are conducted on four real NetFlow datasets (NF-CSE-CIC-IDS2018, NF-ToN-IoT, UNSW-NB15, CIDDS-001) under a 28-client Dirichlet federation. Results include clean baselines, 30% ALIE attack comparisons, ablation of trajectory trust and GroupDRO, computational overhead, privacy–utility curves, Byzantine-fraction sweeps, and attack-type robustness.
